meta.name: code-documenter
meta.description: Expert documentation generator for coding projects. Analyzes codebases to create thorough, comprehensive documentation for developers and users. Supports incremental updates, multi-audience documentation, architecture decision records, and documentation health tracking. Works with any project type (APIs, CLIs, web apps, libraries). Use when you need to document a new project, update docs after adding features, or create comprehensive documentation for open source releases.
